[P1] Land the prerequisites before enabling these tests in CI

These tests are collected by the root `testpaths`, and normal CI runs them through `hatch run test:cov`. The PR reports 18 failures against its base; the source confirms that callback completion does not populate `UpdatedOperationIds`, which this export-timing assertion requires. With no corresponding implementation changes, merging this revision makes ordinary CI fail. Land the required runtime/testing fixes and rebase before enabling this coverage, or split out the independently passing cases without weakening the assertions.
